poem.title: 送元二使安西
poem.author: 王维
poem.text: 渭城朝雨浥轻尘，客舍青青柳色新。劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人。

translation:
**Seeing Off Yuan Er on His Mission to Anxi**  
*Wang Wei*

Morning rain at Weicheng has settled the light dust;  
By the travelers’ inn, the willows are fresh and green.  
Drink, my friend, one more cup of wine—  
West beyond Yang Pass, there will be no old friends.
